statements.impact_statement: Measured 2026-11-16 on MicroBin 2.1.0. lexical-core 0.7.6 comes in through nom 6, a dependency of askama_shared 0.11.2 (askama 0.10). askama_shared uses nom only in its template parser (src/parser.rs is the only file that imports nom). The parser is called by askama_derive at compile time (askama_derive 0.10.5 src/lib.rs:5, 47 and 80); the askama runtime re-exports only filters, helpers, read_config_file, Error, MarkupDisplay and Result (askama 0.10.5 src/lib.rs:96-98). MicroBin uses askama only through #[derive(Template)] and never calls askama_shared::parser, so no lexical-core parse function runs in the server. Revisit when MicroBin moves to askama 0.11 or later (nom 7, no lexical-core).
